description: An underwriting manager must decide whether to renew an exporter's trade-credit insurance facility and set the insured limit, buyer concentration control, reporting frequency, security assignment, and cash margin, with input from risk, compliance, legal, and relationship management.

shared_context.S1: The exporter is requesting renewal of a trade-credit insurance facility covering invoices with a face value of $12,000,000.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the binding underwriting decision.
shared_context.S3: The exporter's submitted receivables ledger shows established sales to several overseas buyers and no recorded payment default in the current policy period.
shared_context.S4: The draft renewal specifies no buyer-concentration limit, no reporting frequency, no security assignment, and no cash-margin requirement.
shared_context.S5: At the weekly facility review, Mara follows the normal process of taking a round of comments from risk, compliance, legal, and relationship management before finalizing the renewal.

PF1.text: While reviewing the buyer ledger this week, Jonas found that one buyer represents 35% of the receivables pool; the underwriting rule for this facility caps insured exposure to any one buyer at 20%, so the renewed insured limit must be set at exactly $8,000,000 rather than the requested $12,000,000.

PF2.text: Leila received a compliance memo this morning confirming that this exporter must provide monthly sanctions-screening and country-exposure reports during the policy period; the requirement has not yet been added to the renewal checklist.

PF3.text: Victor found in the master policy review this week that coverage can be renewed only if the bank receives an assignment of insurance proceeds and is named as loss payee; the draft renewal contains neither protection.

PF4.text: Nadia confirmed with the exporter yesterday that it will place exactly $1,000,000 in a blocked cash-margin account for this renewal, which makes the reduced facility acceptable to underwriting; the confirmation is in her client notes but has not been circulated.

acceptance_conditions: The facility must be renewed with an insured limit of exactly $8,000,000.
Insured exposure to any single buyer must be capped at exactly 20% of the receivables pool.
Monthly sanctions-screening and country-exposure reporting must be required.
The bank must receive an assignment of insurance proceeds and be named as loss payee.
Exactly $1,000,000 must be placed in a blocked cash-margin account.
The renewal must include commitments implementing the monthly reporting, insurance-proceeds assignment, and blocked cash margin.
The buyer-concentration finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C7: ('monthly' in decisions['reporting_frequency'] or 'Monthly' in decisions['reporting_frequency']) and any('reporting' in c.get('type', '') and ('sanctions-screening' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Sanctions-screening' in c.get('detail', '')) and 'country-exposure' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: decisions['insurance_proceeds_assignment_required'] == True and decisions['loss_payee_required'] == True and any(('assignment of insurance proceeds' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Assignment of insurance proceeds' in c.get('detail', '')) and (('loss payee' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('loss-payee' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('Loss payee' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('Loss-payee' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: decisions['blocked_cash_margin_usd'] == 1000000 and any(('$1,000,000' in c.get('detail', '') or '1,000,000' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('cash-margin' in c.get('detail', '') or 'cash margin' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The submitted ledger supports the requested $12,000,000 facility on its face, but PF1 changes the insured limit to exactly $8,000,000 and the single-buyer cap to exactly 20%.
The draft has no reporting schedule, while PF2 changes reporting_frequency from unspecified to exactly monthly and requires the monthly compliance reporting commitment.
The draft lacks both protections, while PF3 changes insurance_proceeds_assignment_required and loss_payee_required to true and requires the insurance proceeds assignment commitment.

Without PF4, the reduced facility has no confirmed credit support and a cautious underwriting decision would not renew it; PF4 changes facility_renewed to true, sets blocked_cash_margin_usd to exactly $1,000,000, and enables the blocked cash margin commitment.
